rows.description: Indicates whether the page conforms to Heritage SG brand guidelines as tagged by the content model.
Live per-venue crowd density indicator level derived from real-time Adobe Analytics session data.
Optional firstFestivalYear field from the AEMaaCS content model for the programme/installation.
Flags presence of the standard government disclaimer on the page.
Page template/type; distinguishes venue detail vs venue listing, programme listing, privacy, terms, cookie policy, etc.
Unique ID of the festival programme or installation displayed or interacted with.
Title of the festival programme or installation being viewed. Mirrors the Programme / Installation Name eVar; enables PathFinder content pathing (BRD 104).
Display title of the programme or installation.
Derived student-cohort indicator from geolocation cluster, visit timing and referral source; not stored as permanent PII, refreshed annually.
Name of the curated self-guided trail presented or followed. Mirrors the Trail Name eVar; enables PathFinder trail-step flow (BRD 501).
Whether optional unlocked content is present and whether it is visible to the (scanned-in) visitor.
Venue associated with the programme/installation or venue page.
Visitor intent classified by Adobe Brand Concierge (programme discovery, trail recommendation, venue info, general festival info).
Outcome of a Brand Concierge interaction for engagement/escalation/failure reporting.
Adobe Target personalisation use case served (your picks tonight, trending with your circle, returning-visitor banner, etc.).
File name of the downloaded document.
File format of the downloaded document.
Human-readable display name of the downloaded document.
Whether an itinerary qualifies as a Community Pick (≥10 unique festival-window adoptions).
Consent action recorded in the consent log (grant/withdraw) for a given tier, effective immediately.
Identifier of the custom itinerary created, shared, viewed or adopted.
Type of inline optimisation suggestion surfaced for itinerary conflicts/inefficiencies (dismissible, non-blocking).
Native device share channel used to share an itinerary (no social OAuth).
Whether location permission was granted (enables proximity sorting) or denied (default listing behaviour).
Installation ID / context captured on a QR scan check-in recorded against the visitor profile.
The moment/context that triggered the registration prompt (QR scan, itinerary adoption, profile, etc.); supports funnel-by-trigger reporting.
Identifier of the curated self-guided trail selected, saved or followed.
Client-side derived zone label passed to Adobe Target; raw GPS is never stored server-side.
Cookie consent categories accepted (Strictly Necessary, Analytics & Performance, Personalisation & Targeting).
State of the three-tier consent model (Tier 0 Functional, Tier 1 Festival Marketing, Tier 2 Year-Round NHB) captured at registration.
Context of the off-site Klook ticketing call-to-action click (which programme/venue the CTA was on).
Topic the visitor subscribed to on newsletter sign-up form submission.
External campaign tracking code (utm_campaign / cid) — Adobe s.campaign.
Industry vertical classification for the project.
Unique identifier for the current project instance.
Human-readable name of the current project.
Time in milliseconds taken to complete the project step.
ISO-8601 timestamp when the project step was completed.
ISO-8601 timestamp when the project step was started.
Unique identifier for the completed project step.
Human-readable name of the completed project step.
Ordinal position of the step within the project flow.
Experience Cloud ID assigned by AEP Web SDK; primary cross-session visitor identifier.
[Hashed — PII] Registered visitor identifier, SHA-256 hashed in JS before entering the data layer; ties email-verified registration to profile.
Registration/authentication state of the visitor; supports optional-registration tracking where unregistered visitors retain full access.
Form or Chat interface the interaction used.
Visible text label of the interaction element.
Type of interaction with the interactive Bras Basah–Bugis precinct MapBox map (pin tap, zoom, directions, etc.).
Name of the clicked CTA / link.
Concatenated interaction type for the click.
Business unit / brand identifier for cross-report-suite roll-up.
Data collection environment used to isolate production from dev/stage traffic; drives the Production Data Only segment.
Human-readable page name for all tagged pages.
Baseline page load time in milliseconds. Pairs with Page Load Time Instances to enable the Avg Page Load Time calculated metric. Supports BRD 1503/1504 Core Web Vitals / performance targets.
Hostname of the server that served the page.
Top-level site section for content grouping (programme, venue, trails, info, etc.).
Full URL of the page the hit was fired on.
HTTP referrer URL for the page view.
